title.zh: 授权阿尔拜省财政主管于1902年5月租用一艘汽艇，费用为八十美元（本币），以运送该省财政主管及其副手从黎牙实比至塔巴科，检查维拉克分办事处的法案
title.en: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE PROVINCIAL TREASURER OF ALBAY TO PAY THE SUM OF EIGHTY DOLLARS, LOCAL CURRENCY, FOR HIRE OF A LAUNCH IN MAY, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND TWO, TO TRANSPORT THE PROVINCIAL TREASURER AND HIS DEPUTY FROM LEGASPI TO TABACO TO INSPECT THE SUBOFFICE OF VIRAC.
title.orig: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE PROVINCIAL TREASURER OF ALBAY TO PAY THE SUM OF EIGHTY DOLLARS, LOCAL CURRENCY, FOR HIRE OF A LAUNCH IN MAY, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND TWO, TO TRANSPORT THE PROVINCIAL TREASURER AND HIS DEPUTY FROM LEGASPI TO TABACO TO INSPECT THE SUBOFFICE OF VIRAC.
title.vi: Đạo luật cho phép Kho bạc Tỉnh Albay chi trả 80 đô la Mỹ (tiền tệ địa phương) để thuê tàu ca nô trong tháng Năm năm 1902 nhằm vận chuyển Kho bạc Tỉnh và Phó Kho bạc từ Legaspi đến Tabaco để kiểm tra Văn phòng Phụ thuộc Virac
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติอนุญาตให้ผู้เก็บภาษีจังหวัดอัลบายจ่ายจำนวน80ดอลลาร์สหรัฐ(สกุลเงินท้องถิ่น)เพื่อเช่าเรือลำหนึ่งในเดือนพฤษภาคมพ.ศ.2445เพื่อขนส่งผู้เก็บภาษีจังหวัดและรองผู้เก็บภาษีจังหวัดจากเลกาสปีไปยังตาบาโกเพื่อตรวจสอบสำนักงานย่อยวิราค
title.id: Undang-Undang Mengizinkan Bendahara Provinsi Albay Membayar Jumlah 80 Dolar Amerika Serikat (mata uang lokal) untuk sewa kapal cepat pada bulan Mei 1902 guna mengangkut Bendahara Provinsi dan Wakilnya dari Legaspi ke Tabaco guna memeriksa Kantor Cabang Virac
title.ms: Akta Membenarkan Bendahari Wilayah Albay membayar jumlah 80 Dolar Amerika Syarikat (mata wang tempatan) untuk menyewa bot laju pada bulan Mei 1902 bagi mengangkut Bendahari Wilayah dan wakilnya dari Legaspi ke Tabaco untuk memeriksa pejabat cawangan Virac

text.en:
The provincial treasurer of Albay is hereby authorized to pay the sum of eighty dollars, local
currency, for hire of a launch in May, nineteen hundred and two, to transport the said treasurer and his deputy
from Legaspi to Tabaco, Province of Albay, to enable them to visit the suboffice of Virac, anything in Act
Numbered One hundred and twenty-two, limiting the traveling expenses of provincial officers of the
Province of Albay, to the contrary notwithstanding.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, October 27, 1902.
